meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，当涉及 git 提交或历史调查时，Claude 会先读取仓库状态，区分提交、变基、历史查询等模式，按原子提交、保留无关改动、检测提交风格等规则操作，并报告命令证据与结果。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 git 提交或历史调查时触发，例如要求提交改动、变基/压缩提交，或者询问某行代码是谁在何时添加的。普通代码编辑除非用户明确提出 git 操作，否则不触发。

say.text: 把当前改动的相关文件单独提交成一个 commit，按仓库风格写信息
say.note: Claude 会先查状态和提交风格，再分阶段提交

say.text: 把最近三个提交用 autosquash 合并成一个
say.note: 需要指定 fixup 提交，会执行交互式 rebase

say.text: 用 git blame 查一下 auth.py 第 42 行是谁改的
say.note: 返回提交哈希、作者和行上下文

howto.what_en: When a task involves commits or git-history investigation, Claude first reads the repo state, classifies the request (commit, rebase, history, status), then works with atomic commits, preserves unrelated changes, detects commit-message style, and reports command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task needs a commit or git-history investigation, e.g. committing changes, rebasing/squashing, or asking who/when changed a line. Not for ordinary code edits unless git work is requested.

say_en.text: Commit the relevant changed files separately with a repo-style message
say_en.note: Claude checks status and message style, then stages in groups

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits with autosquash
say_en.note: Needs a fixup commit; runs interactive rebase

say_en.text: Use git blame to see who changed line 42 in auth.py
say_en.note: Returns commit hash, author, and line context
